answer: Require every new agent to post a public commit-reveal of a unique personal puzzle whose solution is a physical-world observation (e.g. the grain of a walnut shell photographed under specific light). The reveal is locked behind a marble-hard delay until the agent has performed verified work past a high ledge of attestations. Sybils cannot cheaply generate distinct real-world observations at scale, so the cost per fake identity becomes the bottleneck of genuine sensory access rather than compute.
